name: Desktop Essentials
description: A starting layout for desktop navigation: right stick for the pointer, left stick for arrow keys, face buttons for clicks and shortcuts, and shoulders for scrolling. See the assignments below for your controller's button names.

name: Browser Essentials
description: A starting browser layout: right stick for the pointer, face buttons for clicks, the address bar and find, shoulders for scrolling, and the D-pad for history and tab navigation. See the assignments below for your controller's button names. Works at the browser application level.

name: Star Trek Online - PS5-style (PC)
description: DualSense starting template for default PC keyboard bindings. Layout 1 Space, 2 Ground, 3 Menus. This is console-inspired, not the console UI: no ability wheels or conditional power automation. Ground: Cross jumps; D-pad Up interacts. Hold L2 for ground camera drag, R3 for space camera drag, while moving the right stick. Ability buttons use numbered PC tray slots: arrange your powers to match the labels. Add an Applications rule for GameClient.exe and reserve Create (SDL button 4) to cycle these layouts; the template leaves Create unassigned. PC camera, pitch and keybind settings can differ. No game/hardware testing performed.

name: Star Trek Online - Xbox-style (PC)
description: Xbox starting template for default PC keyboard bindings: Space, Ground and Menus. Console-inspired PC mapping; no console ability wheels or conditional automation. A jumps on Ground; D-pad Up interacts. Hold LT for ground camera drag or right stick click in Space. Powers use numbered tray slots; arrange them to match the labels. Reserve View / Back (SDL button 4) in an Applications rule for GameClient.exe to cycle layouts. Standard Xbox controls work without Elite paddles. Hardware and gameplay are untested.

name: Star Trek Online - Steam Controller (2015)
description: Physical Valve Steam Controller (2015) starting template for default PC bindings: Space, Ground and Menus. Reserve Back / Menu (SDL button 4) to cycle layouts through a GameClient.exe Applications rule. Right touchpad moves the pointer; press it to drag the camera in Space/Ground or select in Menus. Grips offer camera drag and sprint/fire shortcuts. Numbered tray powers need arrangement in STO. Console radial menus and automation are not reproduced. Use Bifrost 0.1.5 or newer with its SDL3 runtime; avoid a simultaneous Steam keyboard/mouse layout. Hardware and gameplay are untested.

name: Desktop - Steam Controller (2015)
description: Physical Steam Controller (2015) navigation. Right touchpad moves the pointer; click it to select. Left touchpad scrolls, stick and face buttons keep keyboard shortcuts. Requires Bifrost 0.1.5 with SDL3. Gyro and other available inputs can be customized in Controllers. Keep Steam from also generating keyboard/mouse input. Hardware behavior is untested.
